name: Phone (Twilio and Vapi)
description: Send and list text messages through Twilio, and place outbound AI phone calls through Vapi.

defaultFrom.title: Default SMS sender
defaultFrom.description: Twilio number (E.164, such as +14155550100), short code or alphanumeric sender id used when twilio_send_sms gets no `from`.

defaultMessagingServiceSid.title: Default Messaging Service SID
defaultMessagingServiceSid.description: Twilio Messaging Service (MG...) used when twilio_send_sms gets no `from`. Takes precedence over the default sender.

defaultAssistantId.title: Default Vapi assistant id
defaultAssistantId.description: Assistant that runs calls placed by vapi_create_call when a call gives none.

defaultPhoneNumberId.title: Default Vapi phone number id
defaultPhoneNumberId.description: Vapi phone number that places calls when a call gives none.

allowedRecipients.title: Allowed recipients
allowedRecipients.description: E.164 numbers or prefixes (such as "+1") that twilio_send_sms and vapi_create_call may reach. Empty (the default) means any number, as before. Agents cannot change this setting.

lockSender.title: Lock sender
lockSender.description: When true and a default sender is configured (defaultFrom or defaultMessagingServiceSid for Twilio, defaultAssistantId plus defaultPhoneNumberId for Vapi), calls cannot override the sender fields. Default false.
